title: Study firstmate's work handling (M1)
summary: The request is to study firstmate's work handling (mechanism M1 in BRIEF.md:306). That is a study of an external repository, which the 'change' capability can't do, so I decline it.
decline_reason: The request needs a 'study' capability. That means cloning and reading the external firstmate repo at a pinned SHA, possibly running it, and writing evidence-backed findings and a formal data model of its work handling (M1). The only available capability, 'change', edits files in this repository, and the firstmate source is not here. Reading it would also be unverifiable with the allowed commands.

defaults_applied.how: Recovered what 'M1' and 'firstmate' mean from BRIEF.md instead of asking.
The reading cites BRIEF.md line numbers for its claims.

assumptions: 'firstmate' is the external repo kunchenguid/firstmate (BRIEF.md:23), and M1 is 'Work handling: from request to done, including failures, retries, and concurrency, modeled formally as data' (BRIEF.md:306).
The firstmate source is not in this repository, so the request cannot be met by editing files here.
The study capability is designed (docs/design/study-capability-m1.md) but is not in the catalog for this job. The catalog has only 'change'.
question: Do you want this done as a 'change' that only documents M1 from material already in the repository? Otherwise the job needs a study capability that can read the firstmate repo.
out_of_scope: Writing study findings or an M1 data model
Changing any file in this repository
departures: This is a decline with no producer or verifier run, so cost and time are far below the reference. The acceptance probability is lower because the user wanted a study and gets none.
